normative_rules.t0_gate: Every applicable T0 control must be independently VERIFIED. Failed, unknown, inconclusive, untested, or stale T0 evidence produces NO-GO (NO_GO_NONCONFORMANT); a business-risk decision cannot change the control result.
normative_rules.t0_gate_zh_CN: 每个适用 T0 控制都必须被独立验证为 VERIFIED；失败、未知、无法判定、未测试或证据过期均产生 NO-GO（NO_GO_NONCONFORMANT），业务风险决定不能改变控制结果。
normative_rules.framework_mappings: Informative only; no certification or exact equivalence is claimed.
normative_rules.framework_mappings_zh_CN: 外部框架映射仅供参考，不构成认证或精确等价声明。

T0.frequency: continuous monitoring where feasible; independent verification at least quarterly and after material change
T0.frequency_zh_CN: 可行时持续监控；至少每季度及重大变更后独立复验

T1.frequency: at least quarterly and after material change
T1.frequency_zh_CN: 至少每季度及重大变更后复验

T2.frequency: at least semi-annually and after material change
T2.frequency_zh_CN: 至少每半年及重大变更后复验

T3.frequency: at least annually, independently, and after material change
T3.frequency_zh_CN: 至少每年独立复验，并在重大变更后复验

T4.frequency: continuous metrics plus quarterly adversarial and failure-mode review
T4.frequency_zh_CN: 持续度量，并至少每季度进行对抗与失败模式复核

minimum_evidence_en: approved service-scoped decision and accountable owner
current obligation, risk, exception, and assurance records
independent review result with scope and expiry
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: 经批准且范围明确的决策与可追责 Owner
当前义务、风险、例外和保证记录
包含范围与有效期的独立复核结果

minimum_evidence_en: authoritative API or system export
owner, tenant, service, lifecycle, and dependency linkage
desired-versus-actual reconciliation result
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: 权威 API 或系统导出
Owner、租户、服务、生命周期和依赖关联
期望状态与实际状态对账结果

minimum_evidence_en: identity, role, policy, and credential configuration export
correlated authorization and audit events
denial, expiry, revocation, or break-glass test
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: 身份、角色、策略与凭据配置导出
关联授权判定与审计事件
拒绝、过期、撤销或 Break-glass 测试

minimum_evidence_en: versioned topology, configuration, allocation, and tenant-scope records
positive and prohibited-path test results
cleanup, quarantine, rollback, restore, or rebuild trace as applicable
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: 版本化拓扑、配置、分配与租户范围记录
正向及禁止路径测试结果
适用的清理、隔离、回滚、恢复或重建轨迹

minimum_evidence_en: ownership, classification, source, lineage, and lifecycle record
access, key, build, provenance, signature, scan, admission, or deletion evidence
authorized negative test and rollback, recall, or recovery result
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: Owner、分类、来源、血缘与生命周期记录
访问、密钥、构建、来源证明、签名、扫描、准入或删除证据
经授权负向测试及回滚、召回或恢复结果

minimum_evidence_en: asset-linked finding or protected event sample
coverage, freshness, time-integrity, and retention result
detection replay, remediation retest, or tamper test
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: 与资产关联的 Finding 或受保护事件样本
覆盖率、新鲜度、时间完整性与保留结果
检测重放、修复复测或篡改测试

minimum_evidence_en: agent owner, identity, delegator, use case, impact, data/tenant/authority scope, and versioned model/prompt/RAG/memory/skill/tool inventory
for tool-using systems: typed tool, policy, credential, egress/data/cost, revocation, and security-relevant trace records
for high-impact or adaptive systems: deterministic approval/stop, protected replayable trace, rollback/manual recovery, and independent-verifier test results
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: Agent Owner、Identity、Delegator、Use Case、Impact、Data/Tenant/Authority Scope，以及版本化 Model/Prompt/RAG/Memory/Skill/Tool Inventory
对 Tool-using System：Typed Tool、Policy、Credential、Egress/Data/Cost、Revocation 与安全相关 Trace Record
对高影响或自适应系统：Deterministic Approval/Stop、受保护可重放 Trace、Rollback/Manual Recovery 与 Independent-verifier Test Result

minimum_evidence_en: case, command, decision, notification, or responsibility record
containment, revocation, capacity, restore, rebuild, or reopening trace
exercise result and independently verified closure
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: Case、指挥、决策、通知或责任记录
隔离、撤销、容量、恢复、重建或开服轨迹
演练结果与独立验证关闭

minimum_evidence_en: facility, device, firmware, BMC/OOB, access, and custody inventory
configuration, access-event, maintenance, and patch evidence
sanitization, reassignment, destruction, or unauthorized-path test
minimum_evidence_zh_CN: 机房、设备、固件、BMC/OOB、访问与保管清单
配置、访问事件、维护与补丁证据
清除、重分配、销毁或未授权路径测试

steps_en: confirm scope and accountable decision authority
sample current records and expired exceptions
verify independent challenge and customer-impact treatment
steps_zh_CN: 确认范围与可追责决策权限
抽样当前记录及过期例外
验证独立挑战与客户影响处理

steps_en: compare independent discovery with authoritative inventory
inject or select an unknown/stale item
verify owner, tenant, and dependency reconciliation
steps_zh_CN: 比较独立发现与权威清单
注入或选择未知/过期对象
验证 Owner、租户与依赖对账

steps_en: reproduce an allowed decision
execute a prohibited or expired path
verify revocation and protected audit at every enforcement point
steps_zh_CN: 复现允许判定
执行禁止或过期路径
验证所有执行点的撤销与受保护审计

steps_en: confirm deployed versions and declared boundary
exercise cross-tenant or management negative paths on the real data path
verify cleanup, mismatch detection, quarantine, and safe recovery
steps_zh_CN: 确认部署版本与声明边界
在真实数据路径执行跨租户或管理面负向测试
验证清理、偏差发现、隔离与安全恢复

steps_en: trace a representative object from source to use and disposal
attempt unauthorized, unsigned-when-required, malicious, revoked, incompatible, or expired handling
verify recall, rollback, deletion, or recovery
steps_zh_CN: 跟踪代表性对象从来源到使用与处置
尝试未授权、在要求签名时未签名、恶意、已吊销、不兼容或过期处理
验证召回、回滚、删除或恢复

steps_en: reconcile required sources and event fields
simulate source loss, relevant behavior, or tamper
verify alert, evidence integrity, and remediation retest
steps_zh_CN: 对账必需数据源与事件字段
模拟数据源丢失、相关行为或篡改
验证告警、证据完整性与修复复测

steps_en: confirm owner, identity, delegation, use case, impact, components, data/tenant/authority scope, monitoring, and incident path
for tool-using or high-impact systems, test untrusted content, approval, scope, egress/data/cost, credential revocation, repeated failure, and destructive-action boundaries
where applicable, confirm deterministic stop, rollback/manual recovery, protected trace, and independent verdict
steps_zh_CN: 确认 Owner、Identity、Delegation、Use Case、Impact、Component、Data/Tenant/Authority Scope、Monitoring 与 Incident Path
对 Tool-using 或高影响系统，测试不可信内容、Approval、Scope、Egress/Data/Cost、Credential Revocation、Repeated Failure 与 Destructive-action Boundary
在适用时确认 Deterministic Stop、Rollback/Manual Recovery、Protected Trace 与 Independent Verdict

steps_en: exercise command and reliable scoping
perform containment, revocation, restore or known-good rebuild
independently verify identity, integrity, isolation, objectives, and reopening
steps_zh_CN: 演练指挥与可靠定界
执行隔离、撤销、恢复或已知可信重建
独立验证身份、完整性、隔离、目标与重新开服

steps_en: inspect facility/device/OOB scope and access paths
test an unauthorized path or representative lifecycle event
verify firmware state, sanitation, custody, and reassignment decision
steps_zh_CN: 检查机房/设备/OOB 范围与访问路径
测试未授权路径或代表性生命周期事件
验证固件状态、清除、保管链与重分配决策

title.en: Governance, risk, compliance, and shared responsibility
title.zh-CN: 治理、风险、合规与共享责任

outcome.en: Accountable decisions, explicit responsibility, controlled exceptions, and independently supportable assurance.
outcome.zh-CN: 形成可追责决策、明确责任、受控例外与可独立验证的保证。

title.en: Asset, service, dependency, and data-flow inventory
title.zh-CN: 资产、服务、依赖与数据流清单

outcome.en: Authoritative knowledge of what exists, who owns it, how it connects, and whether actual state matches intent.
outcome.zh-CN: 权威掌握资产、Owner、连接关系及实际状态是否符合意图。

title.en: Human, tenant, workload, and agent identity
title.zh-CN: 人员、租户、工作负载与 Agent 身份

outcome.en: Every acting subject has a strong, scoped, and reviewable identity; credentials, sessions, privilege grants, and delegated authority are short-lived where technically feasible.
outcome.zh-CN: 每个行动主体都具有强、受限且可复核的身份；在技术可行时，Credential、Session、Privilege Grant 与 Delegated Authority 应短期化。

title.en: Control plane, API, and administrative interfaces
title.zh-CN: 控制面、API 与管理接口

outcome.en: Tenant-correct authorization, private administration, abuse resistance, traceable change, and safe failure.
outcome.zh-CN: 实现租户正确授权、私有管理、抗滥用、变更可追踪与安全失败。

title.en: Network, fabric, RDMA/InfiniBand, and DPU isolation
title.zh-CN: 网络、高性能互联、RDMA/InfiniBand 与 DPU 隔离

outcome.en: Proven separation across packet, storage, management, and direct-memory paths.
outcome.zh-CN: 在报文、存储、管理和直接内存路径上证明隔离。

title.en: Compute, hypervisor, bare metal, GPU, and accelerator isolation
title.zh-CN: 计算、虚拟化、裸金属、GPU 与加速器隔离

outcome.en: Declared isolation, safe allocation and reset, hardened hosts, trusted provisioning, and higher-assurance options.
outcome.zh-CN: 隔离属性明确，分配与重置安全，Host 加固，供应可信并提供高保证选项。

title.en: Kubernetes, containers, Slurm, and scheduler security
title.zh-CN: Kubernetes、容器、Slurm 与调度安全

outcome.en: Secure controllers, authorization, admission, scheduling, runtime, cleanup, backup, and recovery.
outcome.zh-CN: 确保控制器、授权、准入、调度、运行时、清理、备份与恢复安全。

title.en: Data, dataset, model, artifact, and privacy protection
title.zh-CN: 数据、数据集、模型、制品与隐私保护

outcome.en: Controlled classification, access, use, lineage, output, retention, deletion, and offboarding.
outcome.zh-CN: 分类、访问、使用、血缘、输出、保留、删除和退租全过程受控。

title.en: Secrets, keys, PKI, attestation, and confidential computing
title.zh-CN: Secret、密钥、PKI、证明与机密计算

outcome.en: Protected cryptographic roots, short-lived secrets, governed key release, and tested recovery.
outcome.zh-CN: 密码信任根受保护，Secret 短期化，密钥释放受治理且恢复经过测试。

title.en: Software, model, and infrastructure supply-chain security
title.zh-CN: 软件、模型与基础设施供应链安全

outcome.en: Known, approved, attributable, verifiable, recallable, and reversible production inputs.
outcome.zh-CN: 生产输入已知、获批、可归因、可验证、可召回且可回滚。

title.en: Secure engineering, infrastructure as code, change, and configuration
title.zh-CN: 安全工程、IaC、变更与配置

outcome.en: Threat-informed design, secure defaults, reviewable change, test gates, drift control, and rollback.
outcome.zh-CN: 实现威胁驱动设计、安全默认、变更可审查、测试门、漂移控制与回滚。

title.en: Vulnerability, exposure, patch, and firmware management
title.zh-CN: 漏洞、暴露面、补丁与固件管理

outcome.en: Continuous discovery and risk-based, deployment-verified remediation across every layer.
outcome.zh-CN: 全层持续发现并按风险修复，且通过部署状态复验闭环。

title.en: Telemetry, detection engineering, threat intelligence, and audit
title.zh-CN: 遥测、检测工程、威胁情报与审计

outcome.en: Required, tenant-safe, tamper-evident evidence and detections tested against relevant threats and failure modes.
outcome.zh-CN: 必需证据租户安全且可发现篡改，检测针对相关威胁与失败模式经过测试。

title.en: AI application, agent, tool, skill, and prompt security
title.zh-CN: AI 应用、Agent、Tool、Skill 与 Prompt 安全

outcome.en: Risk-proportionate control of authority, context, components, tools, approvals, stops, traces, recovery, and independent verification.
outcome.zh-CN: 按风险治理 Authority、Context、Component、Tool、Approval、Stop、Trace、Recovery 与 Independent Verification。

title.en: Abuse prevention, tenant trust, egress, and acceptable use
title.zh-CN: 滥用防护、租户信任、出网与可接受使用

outcome.en: Proportional onboarding, resource and external-interaction controls, misuse detection, safe enforcement, and appeal.
outcome.zh-CN: 分级准入、资源和外部交互控制、误用检测、安全执行与申诉。

title.en: Incident response, forensics, crisis management, and recovery
title.zh-CN: 事件响应、取证、危机管理与恢复

outcome.en: Fast command, evidence preservation, safe containment, defensible notification, recovery, and verified closure.
outcome.zh-CN: 快速指挥、证据保全、安全隔离、可辩护通知、恢复与验证关闭。

title.en: Resilience, availability, capacity, backup, and disaster recovery
title.zh-CN: 韧性、可用性、容量、备份与灾难恢复

outcome.en: Safe degraded behavior, protected backup, tested failover/restore/rebuild, and verified reopening.
outcome.zh-CN: 安全降级、受保护备份、经过测试的切换/恢复/重建与验证开服。

title.en: Physical, facility, BMC, hardware lifecycle, and media sanitization
title.zh-CN: 物理、机房、BMC、硬件生命周期与介质清除

outcome.en: Controlled facilities and hardware roots, isolated OOB, trustworthy device state, and verifiable sanitization.
outcome.zh-CN: 机房和硬件信任根受控，OOB 隔离，设备状态可信，清除可验证。

title.en: Security mandate and accountable ownership
title.zh-CN: 安全授权与可追责 Owner

requirement.en: The provider MUST establish a security mandate and accountable ownership for every applicable production service and critical root.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须为每个适用生产服务与关键信任根建立安全授权和可追责 Owner。

title.en: Shared responsibility and security commitments
title.zh-CN: 共享责任与安全承诺

requirement.en: The provider MUST publish and operate service-scoped provider, customer, and shared security responsibilities and commitments.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须发布并落实服务范围内的服务商、客户及共同安全责任与承诺。

title.en: Risk and threat-model governance
title.zh-CN: 风险与威胁建模治理

requirement.en: The provider MUST maintain service-scoped risk and threat models, decision ownership, review triggers, and remediation tracking.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须维护服务范围内的风险与威胁模型、决策 Owner、复核触发条件和整改跟踪。

title.en: Compliance, privacy, and sovereignty governance
title.zh-CN: 合规、隐私与主权治理

requirement.en: The provider MUST determine and implement applicable compliance, privacy, residency, sovereignty, and contractual obligations by service and jurisdiction.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须按服务与司法辖区识别并实施适用的合规、隐私、驻留、主权和合同义务。

title.en: Exception, assurance, and independent-verification governance
title.zh-CN: 例外、保证与独立验证治理

requirement.en: The provider MUST govern exceptions, evidence, assurance claims, expiry, residual risk, and independent verification without masking failed T0 controls.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须治理例外、证据、保证声明、有效期、残余风险和独立验证，且不得掩盖失败 T0。

title.en: Authoritative production service and asset inventory
title.zh-CN: 权威生产服务与资产清单

requirement.en: The provider MUST maintain an authoritative inventory of production services, assets, owners, tenant scope, location, lifecycle, and criticality.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须维护包含生产服务、资产、Owner、租户范围、位置、生命周期与关键性的权威清单。

title.en: Identity, software, data, and model inventory
title.zh-CN: 身份、软件、数据与模型清单

requirement.en: The provider MUST inventory identities, deployed software and firmware, data, models, checkpoints, artifacts, keys, and security-relevant versions.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须盘点身份、已部署软件与固件、数据、模型、Checkpoint、制品、密钥和安全相关版本。

title.en: Data flows and trust boundaries
title.zh-CN: 数据流与信任边界

requirement.en: The provider MUST document and validate material data, identity, control, management, fabric, support, and evidence flows across trust boundaries.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须记录并验证跨信任边界的重要数据、身份、控制、管理、Fabric、支持和证据流。

title.en: Dependency and service relationship graph
title.zh-CN: 依赖与服务关系图

requirement.en: The provider MUST maintain a queryable relationship graph linking services, tenants, identities, workloads, infrastructure, data/models, artifacts, controls, risks, and evidence.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须维护可查询关系图，关联服务、租户、身份、工作负载、基础设施、数据/模型、制品、控制、风险和证据。

title.en: Continuous discovery and control-scope reconciliation
title.zh-CN: 持续发现与控制范围对账

requirement.en: For assured services, the provider MUST continuously compare independent discovery and actual state with authoritative scope and surface material divergence.
requirement.zh-CN: 对可信级服务，服务商必须持续比较独立发现、实际状态与权威范围，并暴露重大偏差。

title.en: Central federation and phishing-resistant MFA
title.zh-CN: 集中联邦与抗钓鱼 MFA

requirement.en: The provider MUST centrally govern human and tenant-owner identity and require approved phishing-resistant MFA for applicable privileged and high-impact access.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须集中治理人员与租户 Owner 身份，并要求适用特权和高影响访问使用批准的抗钓鱼 MFA。

title.en: Least privilege, JIT administration, and break-glass
title.zh-CN: 最小权限、JIT 管理与 Break-glass

requirement.en: The provider MUST minimize standing privilege, use task-bound JIT/JEA access, prohibit shared administrators, and protect and test break-glass.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须最小化长期特权，使用任务绑定的 JIT/JEA，禁止共享管理员，并保护和测试 Break-glass。

title.en: Attested workload and service identity
title.zh-CN: 经过证明的工作负载与服务身份

requirement.en: The provider MUST issue scoped, audience-restricted, short-lived credentials for workload and service identities and bind identity or credential release to attested state where justified.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须为 Workload 与 Service Identity 签发范围受限、Audience 受限的 Short-lived Credential，并在合理场景将 Identity 或 Credential Release 绑定到 Attested State。

title.en: Tenant, service-account, and access lifecycle
title.zh-CN: 租户、服务账户与访问生命周期

requirement.en: The provider MUST govern tenant, user, service-account, device, and credential creation, review, rotation, suspension, revocation, and deletion.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须治理租户、用户、服务账户、设备和凭据的创建、复核、轮换、暂停、撤销与删除。

title.en: Agent identity, delegation, and action scope
title.zh-CN: Agent 身份、委托与动作范围

requirement.en: The provider MUST assign each production agent an accountable owner, unique identity, explicit delegator and use case, bounded data/tenant/tool authority, review or expiry, monitoring, incident path, and attributable actions; high-impact workflows MUST additionally bind immutable goal and scope.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须为每个生产 Agent 指定 Accountable Owner、Unique Identity、Explicit Delegator/Use Case、受限 Data/Tenant/Tool Authority、Review 或 Expiry、Monitoring、Incident Path 与可归因 Action；高影响 Workflow 还必须绑定不可变 Goal 与 Scope。

title.en: Tenant-correct API authentication and authorization
title.zh-CN: 租户正确的 API 认证与授权

requirement.en: Every critical public and internal API MUST identify the subject, including explicit anonymous/untrusted status where permitted; before tenant-specific, privileged, state-changing, costly, or sensitive actions, it MUST authenticate as required and enforce server-side object, action, tenant, purpose, and context authorization.
requirement.zh-CN: 每个关键公网与内部 API 都必须识别 Subject，并在允许匿名时显式标记为 Anonymous/Untrusted；在执行 Tenant-specific、Privileged、State-changing、高成本或敏感动作前，必须按要求完成 Authentication，并在服务端执行 Object、Action、Tenant、Purpose 与 Context Authorization。

title.en: Private and governed administrative interfaces
title.zh-CN: 私有且受治理的管理接口

requirement.en: Provider administration, support, debug, controller, database, fabric, and BMC/OOB interfaces MUST use private governed paths and must not be directly reachable from public or tenant data planes.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商管理、支持、调试、Controller、Database、Fabric 与 BMC/OOB 接口必须走私有受控路径，且不得从公网或租户数据面直达。

title.en: API abuse resistance and resource controls
title.zh-CN: API 抗滥用与资源控制

requirement.en: The provider MUST enforce schema, payload, replay, idempotency, rate, quota, cost, and concurrency controls appropriate to each API and tenant trust tier.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须按 API 与租户信任级别实施 Schema、Payload、Replay、Idempotency、Rate、Quota、Cost 和 Concurrency 控制。

title.en: Control-plane change integrity and audit
title.zh-CN: 控制面变更完整性与审计

requirement.en: High-impact control-plane changes MUST preserve actor, tenant, request, policy, approval, desired state, actual state, result, and rollback evidence.
requirement.zh-CN: 高影响控制面变更必须保留 Actor、Tenant、Request、Policy、Approval、Desired State、Actual State、Result 与 Rollback 证据。

title.en: Secure API lifecycle, testing, and deprecation
title.zh-CN: 安全 API 生命周期、测试与退役

requirement.en: The provider MUST inventory, threat-model, test, version, monitor, safely deprecate, and remove APIs and credentials without leaving unauthorized legacy paths.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须盘点、威胁建模、测试、版本化、监控、安全退役和删除 API 与凭据，且不得遗留未授权旧路径。

title.en: Security-plane separation and default deny
title.zh-CN: 安全平面分离与默认拒绝

requirement.en: The provider MUST separate public, tenant, storage, cluster, migration, provider-management, security-evidence, and BMC/OOB planes and enforce default deny between them.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须分离公网、租户、存储、集群、迁移、服务商管理、安全证据和 BMC/OOB 平面，并在平面间默认拒绝。

title.en: End-to-end per-tenant network, storage, and fabric isolation
title.zh-CN: 端到端租户网络、存储与 Fabric 隔离

requirement.en: The provider MUST preserve and enforce tenant identity across Ethernet, storage, InfiniBand/RDMA, NVLink-aware placement, DPU/NIC, and support paths.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须在以太网、存储、InfiniBand/RDMA、NVLink 感知放置、DPU/NIC 与支持路径中保留并执行租户身份。

title.en: InfiniBand P_Key and RDMA isolation validation
title.zh-CN: InfiniBand P_Key 与 RDMA 隔离验证

requirement.en: The provider MUST explicitly own, configure, reconcile, and test P_Key membership, RDMA reachability, fabric-manager authority, stale state, and reassignment cleanup.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须明确负责、配置、对账并测试 P_Key Membership、RDMA Reachability、Fabric Manager 权限、过期状态与重分配清理。

title.en: Egress, DPU/NIC, and out-of-band isolation
title.zh-CN: 出网、DPU/NIC 与带外隔离

requirement.en: The provider MUST govern tenant and agent egress, protect DPU/NIC control, and isolate OOB paths from public, tenant, and ordinary corporate networks.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须治理租户与 Agent 出网、保护 DPU/NIC 控制，并将 OOB 与公网、租户及普通办公网络隔离。

title.en: Continuous path and isolation assurance
title.zh-CN: 持续路径与隔离保证

requirement.en: For assured services, the provider MUST continuously reconcile path intent and actual state and regularly exercise tenant, management, storage, RDMA, DPU, and OOB negative paths.
requirement.zh-CN: 对可信级服务，服务商必须持续对账路径意图与实际状态，并定期测试租户、管理、存储、RDMA、DPU 与 OOB 负向路径。

title.en: Declared isolation model for every compute SKU
title.zh-CN: 每种计算 SKU 的明确隔离模型

requirement.en: Every commercial compute SKU MUST declare and test host, hypervisor/container, GPU/HBM/cache, NVLink, fabric, storage, telemetry, and support isolation properties and limitations.
requirement.zh-CN: 每种商业计算 SKU 都必须声明并测试 Host、Hypervisor/Container、GPU/HBM/Cache、NVLink、Fabric、Storage、Telemetry 与 Support 隔离属性及限制。

title.en: Safe accelerator sharing, reset, and memory handling
title.zh-CN: 安全加速器共享、重置与显存处理

requirement.en: The provider MUST distinguish full-device dedication, hardware partitioning, virtualization, and time-slicing; select modes by threat model; never treat time-slicing as memory or fault isolation; prevent sensitive placement on insufficient boundaries; and verify reset, error containment, quarantine, memory handling, and inter-tenant cleanup on the deployed stack.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须区分整卡独占、硬件分区、虚拟化与 Time-slicing，按 Threat Model 选择模式，不得把 Time-slicing 当作 Memory/Fault Isolation，禁止敏感任务使用不足边界，并在真实部署 Stack 上验证 Reset、Error Containment、Quarantine、Memory Handling 与跨租户 Cleanup。

title.en: Host, hypervisor, and container hardening
title.zh-CN: Host、Hypervisor 与容器加固

requirement.en: The provider MUST harden, minimize, patch, monitor, and rapidly isolate or rebuild hosts, hypervisors, runtimes, kernels, drivers, and privileged services.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须加固、最小化、修补、监控，并能够快速隔离或重建 Host、Hypervisor、Runtime、Kernel、Driver 与特权服务。

title.en: Secure provisioning, measured state, and attestation
title.zh-CN: 安全供应、度量状态与证明

requirement.en: The provider MUST use approved provisioning sources, preserve hardware/software lineage, measure critical state, and apply attestation to admission or key release where justified.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须使用批准供应源、保留软硬件血缘、度量关键状态，并在合理场景将证明用于准入或密钥释放。

title.en: High-assurance compute and side-channel controls
title.zh-CN: 高保证计算与侧信道控制

requirement.en: For assured services, the provider MUST implement service-specific dedicated, confidential, attested, topology-aware, and side-channel controls justified by the threat model.
requirement.zh-CN: 对可信级服务，服务商必须按威胁模型实施服务特定的专属、机密、证明、拓扑感知与侧信道控制。

title.en: Hardened and private orchestrator control planes
title.zh-CN: 加固且私有的编排控制面

requirement.en: Kubernetes, Slurm, scheduler, controller, database, and orchestration management planes MUST be private, strongly authenticated, patched, separated, backed up, and recoverable.
requirement.zh-CN: Kubernetes、Slurm、Scheduler、Controller、Database 与编排管理面必须私有、强认证、已修补、隔离、备份且可恢复。

title.en: RBAC, admission, job, and privileged-workload controls
title.zh-CN: RBAC、准入、作业与特权工作负载控制

requirement.en: The provider MUST enforce least-privilege RBAC, restricted admission/job policy, and explicit control of host, device, network, mount, plugin, and privileged access.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须实施最小权限 RBAC、受限准入/作业策略，并显式控制 Host、Device、Network、Mount、Plugin 与特权访问。

title.en: Tenant scheduling, quotas, and placement boundaries
title.zh-CN: 租户调度、配额与放置边界

requirement.en: The provider MUST enforce tenant-aware namespace/account/partition/queue, quota, priority, reservation, topology, node, GPU, fabric, and data placement boundaries.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须执行租户感知的 Namespace/Account/Partition/Queue、Quota、Priority、Reservation、Topology、Node、GPU、Fabric 与 Data Placement 边界。

title.en: Runtime, node, secret, and plugin security
title.zh-CN: 运行时、节点、Secret 与插件安全

requirement.en: The provider MUST secure node images, runtimes, CNI/CSI/device plugins, operators, webhooks, modules, prolog/epilog, service identities, secrets, and node response.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须保护 Node Image、Runtime、CNI/CSI/Device Plugin、Operator、Webhook、Module、Prolog/Epilog、Service Identity、Secret 与 Node Response。

title.en: Orchestrator backup, recovery, and adversarial validation
title.zh-CN: 编排系统备份、恢复与对抗验证

requirement.en: The provider MUST back up, restore or rebuild, and adversarially validate orchestrator control state, accounting, tenant boundaries, plugins, and safe degraded behavior.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须备份、恢复或重建，并对抗验证编排控制状态、Accounting、租户边界、Plugin 与安全降级行为。

title.en: Data and model classification, ownership, and lifecycle
title.zh-CN: 数据与模型分类、Owner 和生命周期

requirement.en: The provider MUST classify and assign ownership, purpose, jurisdiction, retention, export, deletion, and incident requirements to crown-jewel data, models, prompts, outputs, checkpoints, embeddings, caches, and backups.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须为 Crown Jewel 数据、模型、Prompt、Output、Checkpoint、Embedding、Cache 与 Backup 定义分类、Owner、目的、司法辖区、保留、导出、删除和事件要求。

title.en: Encryption, tenant separation, and access control
title.zh-CN: 加密、租户分离与访问控制

requirement.en: The provider MUST enforce tenant-correct access and approved encryption and key ownership for data/models in transit, at rest, in snapshots/backups, and where justified in use.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须对传输中、静态、Snapshot/Backup 中以及合理场景使用中的数据/模型实施租户正确访问、批准的加密和密钥所有权。

title.en: Lineage, integrity, and safe artifact handling
title.zh-CN: 血缘、完整性与安全制品处理

requirement.en: The provider MUST preserve source-to-use lineage and integrity and restrict unsafe formats, deserialization, poisoning paths, and untrusted executable content.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须保留 Source-to-Use 血缘与完整性，并限制不安全格式、反序列化、投毒路径与不可信可执行内容。

title.en: Deletion, export, tenant offboarding, and sanitization
title.zh-CN: 删除、导出、退租与清除

requirement.en: The provider MUST implement authorized export, revocation, deletion, cache/snapshot/backup treatment, tenant offboarding, and verifiable sanitization within stated commitments.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须在承诺范围内实施授权导出、撤销、删除、Cache/Snapshot/Backup 处理、租户退租和可验证清除。

title.en: Privacy, DLP, and sensitive telemetry/output protection
title.zh-CN: 隐私、DLP 与敏感遥测/输出保护

requirement.en: The provider MUST minimize, partition, mask, monitor, retain, and authorize sensitive inputs, outputs, logs, traces, support data, and model-derived information.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须对敏感 Input、Output、Log、Trace、Support Data 与 Model-derived Information 实施最小化、分区、脱敏、监控、保留与授权。

title.en: Central KMS/HSM, key hierarchy, and root protection
title.zh-CN: 集中 KMS/HSM、密钥层级与 Root 保护

requirement.en: Critical encryption, signing, identity, attestation, and recovery roots MUST be centrally inventoried, protected, access-controlled, audited, separated, backed up or recoverable, and tested.
requirement.zh-CN: 关键加密、签名、身份、证明与恢复 Root 必须集中盘点、保护、访问控制、审计、职责分离、备份或可恢复并经过测试。

title.en: Secret lifecycle and elimination of static credentials
title.zh-CN: Secret 生命周期与静态凭据消除

requirement.en: The provider MUST centrally govern secret creation, distribution, use, rotation, revocation, scanning, and deletion and eliminate static or embedded credentials except approved expiring exceptions.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须集中治理 Secret 创建、分发、使用、轮换、撤销、扫描与删除，并消除静态或嵌入式凭据，除非存在获批且到期的例外。

title.en: PKI, certificate, and service-identity rotation
title.zh-CN: PKI、证书与服务身份轮换

requirement.en: The provider MUST inventory, scope, issue, renew, rotate, revoke, and monitor certificates and service identities with tested emergency revocation.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须盘点、限定范围、签发、续期、轮换、撤销并监控 Certificate 与 Service Identity，并测试紧急撤销。

title.en: Attestation-governed admission and key release
title.zh-CN: 证明驱动的准入与密钥释放

requirement.en: For assured services, admission and sensitive key release MUST evaluate current identity, measured state, policy, nonce/freshness, tenant, workload, and revocation context.
requirement.zh-CN: 对可信级服务，准入与敏感密钥释放必须评估当前 Identity、Measured State、Policy、Nonce/Freshness、Tenant、Workload 与 Revocation Context。

title.en: Cryptographic agility and trust-root recovery
title.zh-CN: 密码敏捷与信任根恢复

requirement.en: The provider MUST maintain algorithm, protocol, key, certificate, signing-root, and dependency inventories and test rotation, compromise recovery, and migration.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须维护 Algorithm、Protocol、Key、Certificate、Signing Root 与依赖清单，并测试轮换、泄露恢复和迁移。

title.en: Approved sources and complete artifact inventory
title.zh-CN: 批准来源与完整制品清单

requirement.en: Production images, packages, operators, drivers, firmware, IaC, models, checkpoints, prompts, skills, and policies MUST come from approved sources and have identity, owner, version, and deployment inventory.
requirement.zh-CN: 生产 Image、Package、Operator、Driver、Firmware、IaC、Model、Checkpoint、Prompt、Skill 与 Policy 必须来自批准来源，并具有 Identity、Owner、Version 与 Deployment Inventory。

title.en: Provenance, signature, and admission verification
title.zh-CN: 来源证明、签名与准入验证

requirement.en: Release-critical artifacts MUST produce and verify applicable inventory/BOM, provenance, signature where required, scanner, compatibility, policy, revocation, and admission evidence before use.
requirement.zh-CN: 发布关键制品必须在使用前生成并验证适用的 Inventory/BOM、Provenance、按要求提供的 Signature、Scanner、Compatibility、Policy、Revocation 与 Admission Evidence。

title.en: Isolated build, release approvals, and rollback
title.zh-CN: 隔离构建、发布审批与回滚

requirement.en: The provider MUST protect source and build identities, isolate high-impact builds, separate approval, stage releases, preserve reproducibility, and test rollback.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须保护 Source 与 Build Identity、隔离高影响构建、分离审批、分阶段发布、保留可复现性并测试回滚。

title.en: Dependency vulnerability, VEX, and open-source risk
title.zh-CN: 依赖漏洞、VEX 与开源风险

requirement.en: The provider MUST inventory direct and transitive dependencies, assess vulnerability reachability and VEX, manage license/source risk, and verify remediation in deployed artifacts.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须盘点直接与传递依赖，评估漏洞可达性与 VEX，治理 License/Source Risk，并在部署制品中验证修复。

title.en: Firmware, driver, operator, and model supply assurance
title.zh-CN: 固件、驱动、Operator 与模型供应保证

requirement.en: The provider MUST apply source, inventory, integrity, vulnerability, compatibility, staged rollout, monitoring, recall, and rollback controls to privileged platform and model artifacts.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须对特权平台与模型制品实施来源、清单、完整性、漏洞、兼容性、分阶段发布、监控、召回与回滚控制。

title.en: Secure development lifecycle and threat-informed design
title.zh-CN: 安全开发生命周期与威胁驱动设计

requirement.en: Material services and changes MUST have current threat models, security requirements, safe defaults, acceptance criteria, unresolved-risk decisions, and rollback before production.
requirement.zh-CN: 重大服务和变更在生产前必须具有当前威胁模型、安全要求、安全默认、验收标准、未解决风险决策和回滚。

title.en: Infrastructure and policy as code with secure defaults
title.zh-CN: IaC/Policy-as-Code 与安全默认

requirement.en: Infrastructure and material security policy MUST be versioned, reviewed, tested, deployed reproducibly, default secure, and continuously compared with actual state.
requirement.zh-CN: 基础设施与重大安全策略必须版本化、审查、测试、可复现部署、默认安全并持续与实际状态对账。

title.en: Protected change, peer review, and separation of duties
title.zh-CN: 受保护变更、同伴 Review 与职责分离

requirement.en: The provider MUST protect source and deployment branches, require attributable peer review, separate high-impact duties, and control emergency changes.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须保护 Source 与 Deployment Branch、要求可归因 Peer Review、分离高影响职责并控制紧急变更。

title.en: Security test gates, canary, and rollback
title.zh-CN: 安全测试门、Canary 与回滚

requirement.en: High-impact releases MUST pass automated and human security gates, use bounded canary or staged deployment, observe defined signals, and support tested rollback.
requirement.zh-CN: 高影响发布必须通过自动与人工安全门，使用受限 Canary/分阶段部署，观察定义信号并支持已测试回滚。

title.en: Engineering privacy, secrets, and observability requirements
title.zh-CN: 工程隐私、Secret 与可观测性要求

requirement.en: Engineering standards MUST define privacy minimization, secret handling, stable identity/correlation, mandatory telemetry, evidence, failure behavior, and supportability before release.
requirement.zh-CN: 工程标准必须在发布前定义隐私最小化、Secret Handling、稳定 Identity/Correlation、必需 Telemetry、Evidence、Failure Behavior 与 Supportability。

title.en: Continuous vulnerability and exposure discovery
title.zh-CN: 持续漏洞与暴露面发现

requirement.en: The provider MUST continuously discover and asset-link vulnerabilities, public exposure, weak configuration, leaked credentials, and unsupported versions across control, runtime, GPU/fabric, firmware, model, and dependency layers.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须持续发现并关联资产层面的漏洞、公网暴露、弱配置、泄露凭据与不支持版本，覆盖控制面、运行时、GPU/Fabric、固件、模型和依赖。

title.en: Risk-based remediation and emergency patching
title.zh-CN: 风险驱动修复与紧急补丁

requirement.en: The provider MUST prioritize by exposure, exploitability, asset/tenant impact, privilege, and blast radius; remediate or isolate within approved SLA; and verify deployed state.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须按 Exposure、Exploitability、Asset/Tenant Impact、Privilege 与 Blast Radius 排序，在批准 SLA 内修复或隔离，并验证部署状态。

title.en: Firmware, driver, and platform patch lifecycle
title.zh-CN: 固件、驱动与平台补丁生命周期

requirement.en: The provider MUST inventory, assess compatibility and security, stage, deploy, verify, rollback, and retire firmware, BMC/DPU/NIC, GPU driver, kernel, hypervisor, runtime, and controller versions.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须盘点、评估兼容性与安全性、分阶段部署、验证、回滚和退役 Firmware、BMC/DPU/NIC、GPU Driver、Kernel、Hypervisor、Runtime 与 Controller Version。

title.en: External attack surface and configuration drift
title.zh-CN: 外部攻击面与配置漂移

requirement.en: The provider MUST independently discover external attack surface and material configuration drift and link each finding to service, tenant, owner, change, risk, and remediation.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须独立发现外部攻击面与重大配置漂移，并将 Finding 关联到 Service、Tenant、Owner、Change、Risk 与 Remediation。

title.en: Independent penetration, isolation, and adversarial testing
title.zh-CN: 独立渗透、隔离与对抗测试

requirement.en: For assured services, qualified independent testing MUST cover API/control plane, identity, Kubernetes/Slurm, host/GPU, fabric/RDMA/DPU, data/model, supply chain, agent, support, and recovery boundaries.
requirement.zh-CN: 对可信级服务，合格独立测试必须覆盖 API/Control Plane、Identity、Kubernetes/Slurm、Host/GPU、Fabric/RDMA/DPU、Data/Model、Supply Chain、Agent、Support 与 Recovery Boundary。

title.en: Centralized, protected, and tenant-safe telemetry
title.zh-CN: 集中、受保护且租户安全的遥测

requirement.en: The provider MUST collect, normalize, correlate, protect, partition, minimize, and monitor required telemetry from identity, policy, API, control, orchestrator, host/GPU/fabric/BMC, data/model, supply, support, agent, and recovery systems.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须采集、规范化、关联、保护、分区、最小化并监控 Identity、Policy、API、Control、Orchestrator、Host/GPU/Fabric/BMC、Data/Model、Supply、Support、Agent 与 Recovery 系统的必需遥测。

title.en: Mandatory audit for roots and control boundaries
title.zh-CN: 信任根与控制边界强制审计

requirement.en: Every use or change of privileged identity, root/signing key, policy, controller, scheduler, fabric/BMC, sensitive data/model, artifact admission, support access, and agent high-impact action MUST produce protected attributable audit.
requirement.zh-CN: 每次特权身份、Root/Signing Key、Policy、Controller、Scheduler、Fabric/BMC、敏感 Data/Model、Artifact Admission、Support Access 与 Agent 高影响动作的使用或变更都必须生成受保护可归因审计。

title.en: Detection engineering mapped to threats
title.zh-CN: 映射威胁的检测工程

requirement.en: The provider MUST derive, version, test, monitor, tune, and retire detections against current service threat models and relevant ATT&CK/ATLAS behaviors.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须基于当前服务威胁模型及相关 ATT&CK/ATLAS 行为派生、版本化、测试、监控、调优和退役 Detection。

title.en: Evidence retention, time integrity, and customer-safe access
title.zh-CN: 证据保留、时间完整性与客户安全访问

requirement.en: The provider MUST protect time, transport, storage, retention, legal hold, access audit, tenant partitioning, redaction, and customer-safe evidence exchange.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须保护 Time、Transport、Storage、Retention、Legal Hold、Access Audit、Tenant Partitioning、Redaction 与客户安全证据交换。

title.en: Continuous control monitoring, hunting, and purple-team validation
title.zh-CN: 持续控制监控、威胁狩猎与 Purple Team

requirement.en: For assured services, the provider MUST continuously evaluate critical control assertions and regularly validate detections and response through threat hunting, behavior replay, and purple-team exercises.
requirement.zh-CN: 对可信级服务，服务商必须持续评估关键控制断言，并通过 Threat Hunting、Behavior Replay 与 Purple Team 定期验证检测和响应。

title.en: AI system and agent inventory with security risk assessment
title.zh-CN: AI 系统与 Agent 清单及安全风险评估

requirement.en: Every production AI system and agent MUST have an owner, identity, use case, model/prompt/RAG/memory/skill/tool versions, data and authority scope, impact assessment, and incident path.
requirement.zh-CN: 每个生产 AI 系统与 Agent 都必须具有 Owner、Identity、Use Case、Model/Prompt/RAG/Memory/Skill/Tool Version、Data/Authority Scope、Impact Assessment 与 Incident Path。

title.en: Input, prompt, output, and schema enforcement
title.zh-CN: 输入、Prompt、输出与 Schema 强制

requirement.en: The provider MUST treat external content as untrusted data and enforce provenance, parsing, typing, schema, context separation, output validation, secret/privacy controls, and safe failure.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须将外部内容视为不可信数据，并实施 Provenance、Parsing、Typing、Schema、Context Separation、Output Validation、Secret/Privacy Control 与 Safe Failure。

title.en: Tool, skill, and connector least privilege with approval gates
title.zh-CN: Tool、Skill 与 Connector 最小权限及审批门

requirement.en: All material agent tools, skills, MCP/tool servers, connectors, credentials, egress, data, tenant, cost, and destructive actions MUST be inventoried, typed, least-privileged, policy-mediated, and deterministically approved where required.
requirement.zh-CN: 所有重大 Agent Tool、Skill、MCP/Tool Server、Connector、Credential、Egress、Data、Tenant、Cost 与 Destructive Action 都必须纳入清单、Typed、最小权限、策略仲裁，并在需要时确定性审批。

title.en: Model, RAG, memory, and skill integrity
title.zh-CN: 模型、RAG、Memory 与 Skill 完整性

requirement.en: The provider MUST inventory, approve, version, provenance-check, scan, isolate, monitor, revoke, and safely update models, RAG sources, memory, prompts, skills, evaluations, and policies.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须盘点、批准、版本化、验证来源、扫描、隔离、监控、吊销并安全更新 Model、RAG Source、Memory、Prompt、Skill、Evaluation 与 Policy。

title.en: Agent trace, deterministic stop, and independent verifier
title.zh-CN: Agent Trace、确定性停止与独立验证

requirement.en: After prerequisites are proven, adaptive workflows SHOULD preserve a protected, replayable, tamper-evident action trace, deterministic success/budget/time/repetition/policy/uncertainty stops, rollback or manual recovery, and an independent verifier that the agent cannot alter.
requirement.zh-CN: 在前置能力被证明后，自适应工作流应保留受保护、可重放且可发现篡改的 Action Trace，具备针对 Success、Budget、Time、Repetition、Policy 与 Uncertainty 的 Deterministic Stop、Rollback 或 Manual Recovery，以及 Agent 无法修改的 Independent Verifier。

title.en: Risk-based tenant identity and trust tiers
title.zh-CN: 风险驱动租户身份与信任分级

requirement.en: The provider MUST apply proportionate tenant identity, business verification, service access, quota, egress, payment, monitoring, and review according to risk and service capability.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须按风险与服务能力，对租户实施适度的身份/企业验证、服务访问、配额、出网、支付、监控与复核。

title.en: Acceptable use, prohibited activity, and abuse response
title.zh-CN: 可接受使用、禁止活动与滥用响应

requirement.en: The provider MUST define enforceable acceptable-use and prohibited-activity rules, a 24x7 urgent-abuse path, safe evidence handling, containment, notification, restoration, and appeal.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须定义可执行的可接受使用与禁止活动规则、7×24 紧急滥用路径、安全证据处理、隔离、通知、恢复与申诉。

title.en: Quota, rate, cost, and capacity protection
title.zh-CN: 配额、速率、成本与容量保护

requirement.en: The provider MUST enforce tenant-aware quota, rate, concurrency, queue, priority, budget, billing, GPU-capacity, and denial-of-wallet controls with tested bypass resistance.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须实施租户感知的 Quota、Rate、Concurrency、Queue、Priority、Budget、Billing、GPU Capacity 与 Denial-of-wallet 控制，并测试抗绕过能力。

title.en: Egress and external-interaction controls
title.zh-CN: 出网与外部交互控制

requirement.en: The provider MUST make tenant and agent external interaction observable and policy-controlled by destination, protocol, identity, data, purpose, risk, rate, and approval.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须使租户与 Agent 外部交互可观测，并按 Destination、Protocol、Identity、Data、Purpose、Risk、Rate 与 Approval 进行策略控制。

title.en: Abuse detection, coordination, and appeal quality
title.zh-CN: 滥用检测、协同与申诉质量

requirement.en: The provider MUST measure and improve abuse detection, analyst decision quality, containment speed, customer/ecosystem coordination, false enforcement, restoration, and appeal outcomes.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须度量并改进滥用检测、分析决策质量、隔离速度、客户/生态协同、错误执行、恢复与申诉结果。

title.en: Incident command, roles, and secure communications
title.zh-CN: 事件指挥、角色与安全通信

requirement.en: The provider MUST maintain a 24x7 path to establish incident command, assign decision roles, use secure communications, preserve evidence, isolate reliably, assess notification, and authorize reopening.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须维护 7×24 路径，以建立事件指挥、分配决策角色、使用安全通信、保全证据、可靠隔离、评估通知并批准重新开服。

title.en: NeoCloud-specific incident playbooks
title.zh-CN: NeoCloud 特定事件 Playbook

requirement.en: The provider MUST maintain executable playbooks for cross-tenant, root/key, API/control plane, Kubernetes/Slurm, GPU/fabric/BMC, data/model, supply-chain, agent, abuse, and destructive availability incidents.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须维护可执行 Playbook，覆盖跨租户、Root/Key、API/Control Plane、Kubernetes/Slurm、GPU/Fabric/BMC、Data/Model、Supply Chain、Agent、Abuse 与破坏性可用性事件。

title.en: Forensic readiness and evidence preservation
title.zh-CN: 取证就绪与证据保全

requirement.en: The provider MUST predefine forensic scope, identities, volatile and persistent sources, collection authority, integrity, tenant/privacy boundaries, custody, retention, and analysis access.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须预定义取证范围、身份、易失/持久数据源、采集权限、完整性、租户/隐私边界、保管链、保留与分析访问。

title.en: Customer, regulator, and ecosystem notification
title.zh-CN: 客户、监管与生态通知

requirement.en: The provider MUST maintain evidence-based, tenant- and jurisdiction-aware decision and communication paths for customers, regulators, law enforcement, suppliers, partners, and the public.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须维护基于证据、感知租户和司法辖区的决策与沟通路径，覆盖客户、监管、执法、供应商、合作方与公众。

title.en: Exercises, lessons learned, and verified closure
title.zh-CN: 演练、经验反馈与验证闭环

requirement.en: The provider MUST exercise material scenarios, measure command/scope/containment/recovery, assign lessons and actions, retest fixes, and require independent evidence before closure.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须演练重大场景，度量 Command/Scope/Containment/Recovery，分配经验与行动项，复测修复，并在关闭前要求独立证据。

title.en: Service objectives, dependency, and recovery requirements
title.zh-CN: 服务目标、依赖与恢复要求

requirement.en: Critical services MUST define SLO, RTO, RPO, data integrity, tenant-isolation, identity/key, dependency, safe-degradation, restoration, and reopening requirements.
requirement.zh-CN: 关键服务必须定义 SLO、RTO、RPO、Data Integrity、Tenant Isolation、Identity/Key、Dependency、Safe Degradation、Restoration 与 Reopening 要求。

title.en: Protected backup and verified restore
title.zh-CN: 受保护备份与验证恢复

requirement.en: Critical provider-managed state and required customer data MUST have protected, access-separated, monitored backup and a tested restore that verifies objectives, integrity, identity, and tenant isolation.
requirement.zh-CN: 关键服务商管理状态和必需客户数据必须具有受保护、访问分离、受监控的备份，并通过验证目标、完整性、身份和租户隔离的恢复测试。

title.en: Control-plane and regional resilience
title.zh-CN: 控制面与 Region 韧性

requirement.en: The provider MUST design and test controller, identity/policy, key, registry, scheduler, fabric, storage, telemetry, support, and regional failure behavior without silent fail-open.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须设计并测试 Controller、Identity/Policy、Key、Registry、Scheduler、Fabric、Storage、Telemetry、Support 与 Region 失败行为，且不得静默 Fail-open。

title.en: Capacity, DDoS, queue, and GPU-exhaustion resilience
title.zh-CN: 容量、DDoS、队列与 GPU 耗尽韧性

requirement.en: The provider MUST monitor and control public-edge, API, controller, queue, scheduler, storage, network/fabric, GPU, billing, and operational capacity and test overload and denial-of-wallet behavior.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须监控并控制 Public Edge、API、Controller、Queue、Scheduler、Storage、Network/Fabric、GPU、Billing 与 Operational Capacity，并测试 Overload 与 Denial-of-wallet 行为。

title.en: Known-good rebuild, disaster recovery, and exit portability
title.zh-CN: 已知可信重建、灾备与退出可迁移性

requirement.en: For assured services, the provider MUST maintain and independently exercise known-good rebuild, disaster recovery, key/root recovery, customer export, dependency substitution, and orderly exit portability.
requirement.zh-CN: 对可信级服务，服务商必须维护并独立演练 Known-good Rebuild、Disaster Recovery、Key/Root Recovery、Customer Export、Dependency Substitution 与有序退出迁移。

title.en: Facility, physical access, and environmental security
title.zh-CN: 机房、物理访问与环境安全

requirement.en: The provider MUST control and monitor facility access, visitors, racks, consoles, parts, maintenance, power, cooling, fire, environmental conditions, and emergency response for production infrastructure.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须控制并监控生产基础设施的机房访问、访客、Rack、Console、零部件、维护、供电、制冷、消防、环境条件与紧急响应。

title.en: BMC and out-of-band root security
title.zh-CN: BMC 与带外信任根安全

requirement.en: BMC, console, rack, firmware, DPU, fabric, and OOB roots MUST be isolated from tenant and ordinary corporate networks, strongly authenticated, least-privileged, patched, monitored, recoverable, and JIT-accessed.
requirement.zh-CN: BMC、Console、Rack、Firmware、DPU、Fabric 与 OOB Root 必须与租户和普通办公网络隔离，并实施强认证、最小权限、补丁、监控、可恢复与 JIT 访问。

title.en: Secure hardware supply, firmware inventory, and lockdown
title.zh-CN: 安全硬件供应、固件清单与锁定

requirement.en: The provider MUST govern hardware suppliers, receipt, identity, provenance, firmware baseline, secure boot and configuration, debug/service interfaces, tamper, maintenance, recall, and replacement.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须治理 Hardware Supplier、Receipt、Identity、Provenance、Firmware Baseline、Secure Boot/Configuration、Debug/Service Interface、Tamper、Maintenance、Recall 与 Replacement。

title.en: Verified accelerator, local-disk, and host sanitization
title.zh-CN: 加速器、本地盘与 Host 清除验证

requirement.en: Before tenant reassignment or release, the provider MUST revoke credentials and verify required GPU/accelerator state reset, local-disk/media sanitization, host reprovisioning, network/fabric removal, and residual-data handling.
requirement.zh-CN: 在租户重分配或释放前，服务商必须撤销凭据并验证 GPU/Accelerator State Reset、本地盘/介质清除、Host Reprovisioning、Network/Fabric Removal 与残留数据处理。

title.en: Decommission, media destruction, and chain of custody
title.zh-CN: 退役、介质销毁与保管链

requirement.en: The provider MUST authorize, track, sanitize or destroy, independently verify, and retain chain-of-custody evidence for decommissioned hosts, accelerators, storage, removable media, network devices, and failed parts.
requirement.zh-CN: 服务商必须对退役 Host、Accelerator、Storage、Removable Media、Network Device 与故障零件进行授权、跟踪、清除或销毁、独立验证并保留保管链证据。
